title: Automated Feedback to Peer Tutors Increases Their Talk Moves and Learner Reasoning but Not the Balance of Talk
abstract: arXiv:2611.07072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated feedback on classroom discourse improves instruction in professional and online teaching contexts, and recent work suggests that delivering similar feedback to learners may strengthen these effects by sharing responsibility for participation. Whether this holds in small-group volunteer tutoring has not been tested. We present results from a randomized controlled trial across two four-week SAT mathematics bootcamps on the Schoolhouse.world platform, involving 1,030 volunteer tutors, 7,443 learners and 6,508 recorded sessions. Tutors were randomly assigned to receive no feedback, automated feedback on their own discourse, or that feedback together with participation feedback delivered to their learners under one of two motivational framings. translated_title: 向同伴导师提供自动化反馈可提升其话语策略与学习者推理，但并未改变谈话的平衡
translated_abstract: 对课堂话语的自动化反馈能够改善专业教学和在线教学情境中的教学质量，近期研究表明，向学习者提供类似的反馈可以通过分担参与责任来强化这些效果。但这种做法是否适用于小组志愿辅导尚未得到检验。我们报告了一项随机对照试验的结果，该试验在 Schoolhouse.world 平台上两个为期四周的 SAT 数学训练营中开展，涉及 1,030 名志愿导师、7,443 名学习者以及 6,508 节被录制的课程。导师被随机分配到以下条件之一：不接收反馈、接收关于自身话语的自动化反馈，或在接收该反馈的同时，向学习者提供参与反馈（采用两种动机框架之一）。给导师的反馈使其引出学习者想法、采纳学习者贡献以及学习者推理水平提高了 8-15%，并且这一模式在两个训练营中都得到了重复验证。然而，导师谈话……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 向同伴志愿导师提供自动化话语反馈，可使其引出学习者想法、采纳学习者贡献及促进学习者推理的能力提升 8-15% 并跨训练营得到重复验证，但并未改变导师与学习者之间的谈话平衡。
en_tdlr: Automated feedback to peer volunteer tutors increased eliciting of learner ideas, uptake of learner contributions, and learner reasoning by 8-15% across two bootcamps, but did not shift the balance of talk between tutors and learners.
